scenarios.description: Obtain an identified screenshot or authorized runtime and compare the entry point.
scenarios.expected: Compare label and association only after a real reference is provided.

scenarios.description: Supply rows A then B, change host rows after activation.
scenarios.expected: Output uses precisely A then B from the captured snapshot; no implicit pagination or selection expansion.

scenarios.description: Supply known synthetic text with commas, quotes, Unicode and embedded newline.
scenarios.expected: Agreed columns round-trip without coercion; CRLF records, UTF-8 without BOM, quote every field and double embedded quotes.

scenarios.description: Supply a future denied actor and restricted field fixture.
scenarios.expected: No unauthorized bytes are offered; enforcement depends on a defined host authority model.

scenarios.description: Inject serialization or delivery failure and then retry.
scenarios.expected: No false success or partial file; invoices unchanged; retry captures fresh snapshot.

scenarios.description: Activate twice during serialization, then again after completion.
scenarios.expected: One in-flight attempt; an explicit later activation starts a new attempt.
